articles.title: 18-year-old Anahat's historic run at Silicon Valley Open comes to an end
articles.summary: India’s Anahat Singh exited the Silicon Valley Open after losing 3-1 to Malaysia’s Sivasangari Subramaniam despite winning the opening game. Sivasangari praised the 18-year-old’s talent and potential after staging a comeback.

articles.title: Tumaini Trial Launch: WHO begins Ebola vaccine study in DRC; aims to protect against Bundibugyo strain
articles.summary: In a historic move, the World Health Organization has launched its inaugural clinical trial for an Ebola vaccine in the Democratic Republic of Congo. This trial aims to assess the efficacy of the Ervebo vaccine against the Bundibugyo virus amid a severe outbreak that has resulted in over 9,700 cases and 4,600 fatalities since May..

articles.title: Selena Gomez’s charity benefit raises $2.7 M for mental health
articles.summary: Selena Gomez proudly hosted the fourth annual Rare Impact Fund Benefit in Los Angeles, successfully raising significant funds for mental health initiatives. The evening took an exciting turn when her husband, Benny Blanco, bid an impressive $25,000 for a special modeling experience with Gomez’s glam team.

articles.title: Watch: Giant waves crash into Taiwan as Typhoon Champi leaves over 500 injured; 1 dead
articles.summary: Typhoon Champi made landfall in Taiwan, resulting in one casualty and more than 500 injuries reported. The storm brought heavy rain and strong winds, leading to widespread power outages affecting over 167,000 homes.

articles.title: Mrbeast Bets On Ai Toy: Star takes 55% of Ball 2; viral hype must prove lasting demand
articles.summary: MrBeast invested $250,000 for a 55% stake in Ball 2, an AI-powered toy, during his debut on Shark Tank. Created by Andrew Brown and Kevin Langdon, the ball uses sensors and a companion app to track movement and generate interactive games.

articles.title: RPSC 2nd Grade Sanskrit Result 2026 released; 1,426 candidates shortlisted for eligibility verification: Check complete details here
articles.summary: The Rajasthan Public Service Commission has declared the RPSC 2nd Grade Sanskrit Result 2026, provisionally shortlisting 1,426 candidates for eligibility verification. The result, released on October 23, includes candidates from Scheduled and Non-Scheduled Areas.

articles.title: UP Board exams 2027: UPMSP sets October 26 deadline for schools to submit classes 9 to 12 student lists
articles.summary: UPMSP has granted 940 schools an extended deadline until October 26, 2026, for student registrations. Schools must generate and submit student lists along with required documents to the District School Inspector.

articles.title: UGC NET December 2026: Facing live photo capture issues? NTA shares steps to resolve them
articles.summary: Candidates facing issues capturing live photographs for the UGC NET December 2026 application should follow NTA's guidance. They are advised to ensure proper lighting and a clear background for their photographs.

articles.title: NEET PG counselling 2026: MCC releases round 1 seat allotment result, check direct link to download
articles.summary: The Medical Counselling Committee has released the provisional seat allotment result for NEET PG Counselling 2026. A total of 28,728 candidates have received provisional seat allotments as of October 23, 2026.

articles.title: Tiger Shroff firing incident prompts FWICE security advisory
articles.summary: Following a concerning shooting event, FWICE has released a statement demanding stronger security protocols for film and television production activities. The federation highlights the importance of conducting comprehensive background checks on all individuals working on set.

articles.title: "See you in Delhi": Diljit Dosanjh confirms his India Aura Tour show
articles.summary: Diljit Dosanjh confirmed his performance in Delhi for his concert on October 30 after earlier concerns. Delhi Police had initially denied permission due to security issues during the festive season.

articles.title: 'Jailer 2' faces controversy in Tamil Nadu
articles.summary: A song was mistakenly played instead of India's National Anthem before the screening of 'Jailer 2'. This incident occurred at Ajantha Ellora Cinemas in Karur, Tamil Nadu, causing significant public attention.

articles.title: Danielle Parton to join the brand ambassador of Dolly Parton’s estate
articles.summary: In a heartfelt tribute, Danielle Parton steps into the role of brand ambassador for her beloved aunt Dolly Parton's estate. Dedicated to honoring Dolly’s remarkable legacy, Danielle is inspired to share intimate stories and lessons learned from her aunt’s life.
